    # In repeated horizontal patterns, the more complete row is the reference.
    # Mark the background-colored positions missing from a matching shorter row.
    flat = [v for row in grid for v in row]
    background = max(set(flat), key=flat.count)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    width = len(grid[0])

                        out[i][c] = 1
    return out
'''
